indicators.pattern: Pill-shaped plan buttons in the pricing row

referenceEvidence: reference hero capture (1440px) - pricing row: three pill-shaped plan buttons
indicators.note: Reference-backed pill buttons, not decorative tag soup.
No italic styling in the implementation.
Only the design system typefaces are used.
No negative letter-spacing.
No invented chrome or nested panels.
Sections are separated by spacing, not rules.
Colours come from the token scale.

indicators.justification: The project card component defines a single border token and the pricing cards use its default variant.
indicators.designSystemReference: shadcn/ui Card: default variant, border token --border
indicators.note: One container level, backed by the component variant.
No diagrams in this page.
Copy is single-pass and does not restate headings.
No decorative code paths.

No eyebrow labels.
No dither or noise textures.
No ASCII imagery.
